notes.title: Demo Patch 1.1.0
notes.notes:
Greetings, heroes! 



Patch 1.1.0 is now live. This patch adds a new unlockable hero, Hector of the shining helm. Hector has unlimited retaliations in combat, and gains a 20% defense bonus.



Patch 1.1.0 also contains several bugfixes, balance updates, and polish improvements. See the full patch notes below for a detailed list of changes.



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45313978/a2b0bf0c7f0802463c926089c73a24f717d90fce.png"]



Patch Notes:

Added Hector, the legendary Trojan warrior! Hector's Talent Shining Helm grants him an innate +20% bonus defense and unlimited retaliations. Use these abilities to protect your units, or win glory for yourself in battle!

Updated Kudos tooltip in Hero panel to clarify the function of kudos

Reduced cost of "Mend" prophecy from 10 to 8 Kudos 

Reduced base duration of "Synthesize" from 1 to 0.5 turns, and reduced zeal-scaling duration of "Synthesize" from 0.5 to 0.34

Tweaked color balance and saturation of ground tiles slightly so that units show up more clearly

Fixed issue where the starting prophecy tooltip in Odyssey setup did not properly account for hero's starting Zeal and Epithet modifiers

Fixed rounding behavior on prophecy durations from banker's rounding (round .5 to nearest even number) to positive rounding (round .5 to larger number)

Updated prophecy "Skepticism" to now remove enemy buffs, in addition to removing debuffs from allies. Kudos cost has been increased to 12 to match the increased power.

Added tooltips to disabled prophecies that explain why the prophecy cannot be cast (e.g. not player hero's turn, not in combat, insufficient kudos, or insufficient health)

Fixed bug in legacy progression level calculation logic where a negative discriminant in the quadratic formula was causing progression level to sometimes incorrectly be calculated as -2,147,483,648 instead of 0

Updated default difficulty level from level 0 to level 1

Fixed issue where hero info tooltip would sometimes show when an epithet was being hovered

Added a semitransparent circle indicator around units hovered over from the turn order queue

Increased Myrmidon speed from 5 to 6

Increased Owl health from 6 to 7

Increased Muse max damage from 10 to 12

Fixed bug where hero epithet tooltips would sometimes display incorrectly during Odyssey setup

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.0.9 (Progression Update)
notes.notes:
Hello!



Patch 1.0.9 has just been released. This patch contains some significant new updates to gameplay systems, including a legacy progression system and unlockable achievement trophies. For full details on what has been added in this update, please see the detailed patch notes below!

The legacy progression system tracks your progress across playthroughs, tracked separately for each patron. Eventually, this system will allow unlocking several new prophecies, epithets, and heroes. For now, Odysseus starts unlocked, and Achilles and Atalanta must be unlocked by gaining a level with Athena and Zeus, respectively. Higher difficulty levels increase the rate at which you gain legacy points, so challenge yourself for increased rewards!



[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45313978/e7d711b5464ca4110c809b62de19152b50e86e8d.png"]



Patch Notes:

Added legacy progression system that tracks cross-run progress, allowing new gameplay content to be unlocked

Added unlockable trophies, an achievement system that also rewards legacy progression points. Note: These are not setup as Steam Achievements in the demo, but will be in the full game release

Added Unlocks to main menu, where unlockable game elements can be toggled and patron legacy levels can be viewed

Added Catalog to main menu, where all heroes, units, prophecies, epithets, and trophies can be viewed along with brief descriptions of each.

Added stat-tracking system, recording progress within and across playthroughs

Improved graphics for Owl unit

Fixed bug where enemy Muses were not able to buff adjacent allies

Fixed bug that occurred when attempting to hover over unit detail tooltips during odyssey setup



As always, feel free to comment or contact us if you have any questions or feedback. Hope you enjoy the latest improvements!

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.0.8

[img src="{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45313978/5751f15c865c727cfdb674cd76a91f274b2db347.png"]

Updated graphics for Centaur

Updated graphics for Muse

Updated graphics for Pegasus

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.0.6
notes.notes:
Hello!

Patch 1.0.6 has just been released. This patch overhauls the graphics for two heroes, Odysseus and Achilles! The patch also brings a few polish improvements and bugfixes.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45313978/3a170c4dde6d9e04f20b1134c01a854b87df8865.png

Patch Notes:

 Improved graphics for Achilles.
 Improved graphics for Odysseus.
 Added new sound effect for fire breathing attacks.
 Updated how hero epithets are applied to allied units. This fixes a bug where the Lion-Hearted wasn't correctly increasing army health. This change also causes hero buffs and debuffs to display both during and outside of battles.
Fixed an issue where unit swap and tutorial sounds were playing on the Music audio bus rather than the Sound Effects audio bus.
Added labels to reroll and health boon previews indicating the exact amount of rerolls/health to be granted as rewards.


{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45313978/3d510dc9ffcc5e439d0a1802f0a2329830b4f44f.png

Please enjoy the new changes!

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.0.5
notes.notes:
Greetings!

Patch 1.0.5  is live, bringing two new Climax encounters and many user experience improvements!

Patch Notes:
  
 Added new Phase 1 Climax option: Striges, cursed bloodthirsty owls.  
 Added new Phase 3 Climax option: Medea, the cunning sorceress.  
 Improved look and feel of buttons and background panels.  
 Fixed an issue where music transitions would wrongly be extended when multiple actions were performed in rapid succession.  
 Improved formatting of boon previews in scene selection.  
 Updated styling of dialog titles.  
 Updated icon for Climax encounters.  
 Allowed right-clicking the active unit panel during a crisis to pull up the full unit info display.  
 Capped max FPS to 60 to limit CPU/GPU usage.  
 Fixed an issue with hotkey bindings where the "Escape" key could not be bound.  
 Added fullscreen support – the default gameplay setting is now fullscreen, with a settings toggle to revert to Windowed mode.  
 Added a setting to hide unit "Action Status" icons during combat.  
  

Thank you for trying out the demo!

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.0.4
notes.notes:
Hello!

Patch 1.0.4 adds a few new settings options to improve the game's playability, along with some balance updates and performance improvements.

Patch Notes:  
 Added setting for adjusting the speed of combat animations.
 Improved alignment of tooltips for epithets and patron synergies.
 Updated look of title logo.
 Added fallback when loading settings, to allow game recovery from an invalid settings file.
 Reduced install size by removing unused resources from builds.  
 Updated "Hide Tutorial" button to disappear when in-game tutorial notifications are already disabled. 
 Updated layout of tutorial popups.  
 Added support for configuring custom hotkey bindings under settings menu.  
 Updated proportions of Myrmidon unit.  
 Added caching for loaded unit images, significantly reducing loading times between actions.  
 Halved ammo count of most ranged units to make ammo stats more relevant.  
 Added color balancing.  
 Added special tooltip for Wait button during unit placement to indicate the effects of waiting during this phase.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45313978/8e6168bd3f8728058d46ee08c4258aba71e7a896.png

Let us know what you think of the changes! Thank you!

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.0.3
notes.notes:
New Hero: Atalanta! Plus Some Additional Updates

Hello everyone!

Biggest news first — Atalanta, the Arcadian Huntress, has been added as a new playable hero! Atalanta famously won the Calydonian boar hunt by wounding the boar with an arrow. Her unique hero talent, "First Shot", makes her the only hero with a ranged attack.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/45313978/10c0212c94874e2f78aa3daf4d41d2d13f64892c.png

Work continues on future content and polish improvements. For now, please enjoy the following changes!

Patch Notes:
[olist]
 Added new hero: Atalanta, the Arcadian Huntress.
 Reduced Basilisk’s health from 27 → 25.
 Increased Cretan Archer’s health from 25 → 30.
 Fixed a bug where damage totals were incorrectly displayed for units receiving collateral damage.
 Renamed Artemis’s synergy to "Wild Huntress".
 Added a Settings menu link in the pause menu.
 Created a higher resolution asset for Myrmidon, as part of a planned touch-up for all unit graphics.
 Added a gradient background to hero health and epithet displays.
 Added a stylized title logo to the main menu.
 Added game version info to the credits display.
[/olist]

As always, your feedback is incredibly helpful in shaping the game! If you have thoughts or run into any issues, feel free to post in the community hub or reach out via email at team@seapanda.xyz.

Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.0.2
notes.notes:
Hello everyone! Thanks for playing the demo for Polytropos: A Tactical Odyssey! This update brings a mix of balance changes, quality-of-life improvements, and bug fixes.

Changes & Fixes:

 Added new crisis topography: Reverse Ambush.
 Added a more comprehensive preview of boons associated with each crisis.
 Fixed an issue where undo/redo buttons wouldn’t display correctly on Steam Deck.
 Added support for right-clicking units during crisis scene selection to view their full information.
 Added support for right-clicking units on the post-crisis summary screen to see their details.
 Increased Barbarian's health from 5 → 6.
 Renamed Arachnid's "Slowing Shots" ability to "Ensnare".
 Renamed Sorceress's "Fire Shots" ability to "Explosive".
 Reduced Amazon's health from 50 → 45 and damage from 12-18 → 12-16.
 Increased Arachnid's value from 100 → 110.
 Increased Huntress's health from 3 → 4.
 Reduced Hoplite's value from 70 → 65.


Your feedback continues to be incredibly helpful in shaping the game! If you have any thoughts or run into issues, feel free to post in the community hub or reach out via email at team@seapanda.xyz.

More updates are on the way as development continues. Thanks for playing!

notes.title: Demo Patch 1.0.1
notes.notes:
Thank you for trying out the demo for Polytropos: A Tactical Odyssey! This patch makes a few small improvements to balance, UI, and sound effects.


 Halved the amount of drachma granted from rerolling with the Circumspect epithet
 Significantly increased the amount of health for the phase 4 enemy hero Talos
 Added new crisis topography: Bottleneck
 Increased the volume of many sound effects
 Increased the size of the tutorial icon, and altered the tutorial hint sound effect to be more noticeable
 Added a note to the pause menu indicating that progress is automatically saved after every action
 Added some key bindings for waiting and defending in a crisis. A dialog was added to the settings menu listing these default key bindings. (Adding support for customizable key bindings is planned in a future update)


I hope you are enjoying the demo! If you have any feedback, please feel free to create a thread in the community hub or email me at team@seapanda.xyz ! I will continue to update this demo until the full release of Polytropos: A Tactical Odyssey, so stay tuned!
